title: The Weeping River
text: A river of tears runs through the Pit, clear and salt and very cold, and the sound of it is the sound of a thousand people weeping. To drink from it is to remember every sorrow. Downstream, a bridge of devils' iron spans it.

options.label: Ford the river with your lips shut tight, and do not taste a drop.

outcomes.text: Across, wet and grieving for things you never lost.
A splash in the mouth, and every sorrow at once.

options.label: The bravest drinks, to know what the river knows.

outcomes.text: Every sorrow, and among them a secret.

options.label: The Leader finds the devils' bridge, and dares whoever keeps it.

outcomes.text: Guarded, and the guards are glad of the company.
